scripts.build:apk: npx expo-doctor && npx eas build --platform android --profile preview
scripts.build:dev: npx expo-doctor && npx eas build --platform android --profile development
scripts.clean: rm -rf android/app/build android/app/.cxx android/build modules/*/android/build modules/*/android/.cxx && find node_modules -maxdepth 3 -type d -regex '.*/android/\(build\|\.cxx\)' -prune -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null; echo cleaned
scripts.clean:all: npm run clean && rm -rf android .expo && echo 'removed android/ and .expo/ too'
scripts.emulator: ANDROID_HOME=$HOME/Library/Android/sdk; $ANDROID_HOME/emulator/emulator -avd Pixel_10 -no-snapshot-load >/dev/null 2>&1 & $ANDROID_HOME/platform-tools/adb wait-for-device; until [ "$($ANDROID_HOME/platform-tools/adb shell getprop sys.boot_completed | tr -d '\r')" = "1" ]; do sleep 2; done; echo 'emulator ready'
scripts.install:apk: ANDROID_HOME=$HOME/Library/Android/sdk; APK=$(ls -t build-output/*.apk 2>/dev/null | head -1); if [ -z "$APK" ]; then echo 'No APK in build-output/ — run npm run build:apk first'; exit 1; fi; echo "Installing $APK"; $ANDROID_HOME/platform-tools/adb install -r "$APK" && $ANDROID_HOME/platform-tools/adb shell monkey -p com.tally.habits -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER 1 >/dev/null && echo launched
